item.title: Trump Organization signs deal for billion-dollar skyscraper on Australia's Gold Coast
item.description: The Trump Organization announced a $1 billion project in Australia last week, building a 91-floor luxury resort and apartments on the Gold Coast.

item.title: Oil rises on Iran fears, but expert says supply is strong — what it means for prices
item.description: Former Energy secretary warns Iran strike fears could disrupt oil supplies through Strait of Hormuz, but strong U.S. production keeps prices stable.

item.title: Supreme Court agrees to take up climate lawsuit against energy companies
item.description: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a major climate lawsuit as local Colorado governments take on energy giants over alleged fossil fuel deception and damages.

item.title: GM recalls thousands of vehicles over transmission issue that could increase risk of crash
item.description: General Motors is recalling model year 2022 Chevrolet Tahoe, GMC Yukon and Cadillac Escalade SUVs for transmission problems, with dealers installing new software.

item.title: Altman calls Musk's space data center plans 'ridiculous' for current AI computing needs
item.description: OpenAI's Sam Altman calls SpaceX's ambitious space data center plans "ridiculous" while Elon Musk pushes for orbital AI computing within two to three years.

item.title: American homebuyers gain most purchasing power since 2022
item.description: Homebuyers' purchasing power rose over $30,300 in past year as median-income households can now afford $331,483 homes with mortgage payments 8.4% lower than last year, Zillow found.

item.title: Toymaker who helped take down Trump's tariffs deems SCOTUS decision 'not enough'
item.description: Supreme Court rules against Trump tariffs as toymaker Rick Woldenberg calls 6-3 decision "not enough" after his company faced taxes exceeding earnings.

item.title: Volvo recalls over 40,000 electric SUVs worldwide over battery fire concerns
item.description: Volvo is recalling over 40,000 EX30 electric SUVs worldwide due to a battery fire risk. Owners are urged to limit charging to 70% until safety repairs are completed.

item.title: CarMax to pay $420K to resolve DOJ allegations over servicemember vehicle repossessions
item.description: CarMax allegedly violated federal law by repossessing servicemembers' vehicles without required court orders, leading to a $420,000 settlement agreement.

item.title: FedEx sues Trump administration for full tariff refunds after Supreme Court ruling on IEEPA
item.description: FedEx sues U.S. government for tariff refunds after Supreme Court ruled Trump's emergency trade duties on imports were unlawful.
